# Final First-Wave Implementation Plan

1. Read global foundation/product-commerce bridge and exact dirty diffs.
2. Add a small explicit route manifest for root-level/nested public products; encode aliases separately from products.
3. Rewrite product discovery to merge first-level filesystem discovery with verified explicit routes and deduplicate by commerce identity.
4. Add pure catalog identity + SKU summary modules in shared commerce.
5. Rewrite catalog badges to prefer explicit product IDs, fall back safely, and render live credit-pack + supporter testimony.
6. Mount catalog merchandising only on Apps/Games routes via the global foundation, keeping ordinary product pages lean.
7. Add game-card identity data through one small clean markup module; app cards already expose `data-app-id`.
8. Rewrite coverage tests after implementation, including all explicit products and alias behavior.
9. Run syntax/tests/line/header/tab/readback checks, then create a planned-vs-actual delta and continue into Wave 2.
